scene: The wall panels slide away, revealing three bustling transit gates.
picture: Flat side-view along a level observatory floor. The girl with her long black braid sits upright in her purple wheelchair, facing the viewer. Far left, a brass steam engine waits on shiny rails. Up high, an airship floats beside a balcony ramp. Far right, a yellow box truck hums at an open bay.

a moored striped airship with an open gangway up high
a square yellow delivery truck parked idling at a loading bay far right
